patches.name: Custom Gallery for GIFs & Stickers
patches.description:
在表情符號/貼圖/GIF 面板加入自訂相簿分頁，可分類管理並直接傳送手機圖片。
Add a custom gallery section in the emoji/stickers/GIFs panel to organize and share phone images.

patches.name: Pins (Pinterest)
patches.description:
在貼圖與 GIF 旁加入 Pins 專屬分頁，支援 Pinterest 搜尋、搜尋紀錄、點擊卡片瀏覽關聯內容，並附有直接傳送按鈕。
Add a dedicated Pins tab next to GIFs and Stickers with Pinterest search, history chips, related pins on card click, and a quick send button.

patches.name: Recent Stickers & GIFs Limit
patches.description:
解除 Recent stickers & GIFs 10 張上限，使所有 recent store 一律讀取 recent_content_suggestion_share_max_count flag。
Remove the 10-item limit for recent stickers and GIFs so all stores read the recent_content_suggestion_share_max_count flag.
